memtweaks.configuration.voxySectionCache: Recently used world sections Voxy keeps in memory, about 262 KB each. Rejoin the world after changing it.
Keeps one in-memory copy of each jar bundled inside another mod's jar instead of up to three. Applies at the next launch.
memtweaks.configuration.entityTexturesOu: Entity Textures Out of Block Atlas
Stops one mod's atlas file from pulling every mod's entity textures into the block atlas, which doubles its size. Turn off if something shows the missing texture.
memtweaks.configuration.shareIdenticalQu: Keeps one copy of each distinct block model face instead of one per model. Turn off if blocks render with wrong or missing faces.
